views.name: v_cash_balances
views.definition:
SELECT a.id AS account_id,
    a.code,
    a.name,
    a.account_type,
    COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN m.direction = 'in'::text THEN m.amount
            ELSE - m.amount
        END), 0::numeric)::numeric(18,0) AS balance
   FROM cash_accounts a
     LEFT JOIN cash_movements m ON m.account_id = a.id
  GROUP BY a.id, a.code, a.name, a.account_type;

views.name: v_sale_item_margin
views.definition:
SELECT si.id AS sale_item_id,
    s.id AS sale_id,
    s.sale_date,
    s.route_id,
    s.customer_id,
    si.product_id,
    p.sku,
    p.name AS product_name,
    si.qty,
    si.unit_price,
    si.discount_pct,
    si.line_amount,
    rc.material_cost_per_yield_unit AS estimated_unit_material_cost,
    si.qty * COALESCE(rc.material_cost_per_yield_unit, 0::numeric) AS estimated_material_cost,
    si.line_amount - si.qty * COALESCE(rc.material_cost_per_yield_unit, 0::numeric) AS estimated_contribution_before_returns_and_route_cost
   FROM sale_items si
     JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
     JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT vrc.recipe_id,
            vrc.product_id,
            vrc.sku,
            vrc.product_name,
            vrc.version_no,
            vrc.effective_date,
            vrc.yield_qty,
            vrc.yield_unit,
            vrc.batch_material_cost,
            vrc.material_cost_per_yield_unit
           FROM v_recipe_cost vrc
          WHERE vrc.product_id = si.product_id AND vrc.effective_date <= s.sale_date
          ORDER BY vrc.effective_date DESC, vrc.version_no DESC
         LIMIT 1) rc ON true;

views.name: v_cash_daily
views.definition:
SELECT txn_date,
    sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE flow_class = 'operating'::text AND direction = 'in'::text) AS operating_in,
    sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE flow_class = 'operating'::text AND direction = 'out'::text) AS operating_out,
    sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE flow_class = 'investing'::text AND direction = 'in'::text) AS investing_in,
    sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE flow_class = 'investing'::text AND direction = 'out'::text) AS investing_out,
    sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE flow_class = 'financing'::text AND direction = 'in'::text) AS financing_in,
    sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE flow_class = 'financing'::text AND direction = 'out'::text) AS financing_out,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN flow_class <> ALL (ARRAY['transfer'::text, 'opening'::text]) THEN
            CASE
                WHEN direction = 'in'::text THEN amount
                ELSE - amount
            END
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END)::numeric(18,0) AS external_net,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN direction = 'in'::text THEN amount
            ELSE - amount
        END)::numeric(18,0) AS balance_change
   FROM cash_movements
  GROUP BY txn_date;

views.name: v_inventory_latest
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.material_id) s.material_id,
    m.code AS material_code,
    m.name AS material_name,
    m.base_unit,
    s.snapshot_date,
    s.closing_qty AS qty_on_hand,
    m.min_stock_qty,
    s.closing_qty <= m.min_stock_qty AND m.min_stock_qty > 0::numeric AS is_low
   FROM inventory_snapshots s
     JOIN materials m ON m.id = s.material_id
  ORDER BY s.material_id, s.snapshot_date DESC, s.created_at DESC;

views.name: v_daily_route_profit
views.definition:
WITH sales_agg AS (
         SELECT s_1.sale_date AS day,
            s_1.route_id,
            sum(s_1.net_amount) AS net_sales
           FROM sales s_1
          GROUP BY s_1.sale_date, s_1.route_id
        ), cogs_agg AS (
         SELECT s_1.sale_date AS day,
            s_1.route_id,
            sum(si.qty * COALESCE(rc.material_cost_per_yield_unit, 0::numeric)) AS estimated_material_cost
           FROM sales s_1
             JOIN sale_items si ON si.sale_id = s_1.id
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT vrc.recipe_id,
                    vrc.product_id,
                    vrc.sku,
                    vrc.product_name,
                    vrc.version_no,
                    vrc.effective_date,
                    vrc.yield_qty,
                    vrc.yield_unit,
                    vrc.batch_material_cost,
                    vrc.material_cost_per_yield_unit
                   FROM v_recipe_cost vrc
                  WHERE vrc.product_id = si.product_id AND vrc.effective_date <= s_1.sale_date
                  ORDER BY vrc.effective_date DESC, vrc.version_no DESC
                 LIMIT 1) rc ON true
          GROUP BY s_1.sale_date, s_1.route_id
        ), external_returns AS (
         SELECT returns.return_date AS day,
            returns.route_id,
            sum(returns.refund_amount) AS returns_amount
           FROM returns
          WHERE returns.sale_id IS NULL
          GROUP BY returns.return_date, returns.route_id
        ), all_returns AS (
         SELECT returns.return_date AS day,
            returns.route_id,
            sum(returns.refund_amount) AS all_returns_amount
           FROM returns
          GROUP BY returns.return_date, returns.route_id
        ), expenses_agg AS (
         SELECT expenses.expense_date AS day,
            expenses.route_id,
            sum(expenses.amount) AS route_expenses
           FROM expenses
          WHERE expenses.route_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY expenses.expense_date, expenses.route_id
        )
 SELECT s.day,
    s.route_id,
    r.name AS route_name,
    s.net_sales,
    COALESCE(c.estimated_material_cost, 0::numeric) AS estimated_material_cost,
    COALESCE(ar.all_returns_amount, 0::numeric) AS returns_amount,
    COALESCE(er.returns_amount, 0::numeric) AS returns_affecting_revenue,
    COALESCE(e.route_expenses, 0::numeric) AS route_expenses,
    s.net_sales - COALESCE(c.estimated_material_cost, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(er.returns_amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(e.route_expenses, 0::numeric) AS estimated_route_contribution
   FROM sales_agg s
     LEFT JOIN routes r ON r.id = s.route_id
     LEFT JOIN cogs_agg c ON c.day = s.day AND NOT c.route_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.route_id
     LEFT JOIN external_returns er ON er.day = s.day AND NOT er.route_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.route_id
     LEFT JOIN all_returns ar ON ar.day = s.day AND NOT ar.route_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.route_id
     LEFT JOIN expenses_agg e ON e.day = s.day AND NOT e.route_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.route_id;

views.name: v_current_labor_costs
views.definition:
SELECT e.role_group,
    sum(c.monthly_salary + c.monthly_allowance + c.monthly_attendance_bonus + c.overtime_rate_per_hour * c.default_overtime_hours_per_day * c.costing_days_per_month + c.meal_cost_per_day * c.costing_days_per_month) AS estimated_monthly_cost,
    sum((c.monthly_salary + c.monthly_allowance + c.monthly_attendance_bonus) / c.costing_days_per_month + c.overtime_rate_per_hour * c.default_overtime_hours_per_day + c.meal_cost_per_day) AS estimated_daily_cost
   FROM employees e
     JOIN employee_compensation_terms c ON c.employee_id = e.id
  WHERE e.is_active AND c.effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE AND (c.effective_to IS NULL OR c.effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE)
  GROUP BY e.role_group;

views.name: v_monthly_overhead_summary
views.definition:
SELECT ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(fixed_costs.monthly_amount_standard), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM fixed_costs
          WHERE fixed_costs.is_active) AS fixed_operating_costs,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(assets.monthly_depreciation), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM assets
          WHERE assets.is_active) AS depreciation_costs,
    (( SELECT COALESCE(sum(fixed_costs.monthly_amount_standard), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM fixed_costs
          WHERE fixed_costs.is_active)) + (( SELECT COALESCE(sum(assets.monthly_depreciation), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM assets
          WHERE assets.is_active)) AS total_monthly_overhead;

views.name: v_latest_material_cost
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (mp.material_id) mp.material_id,
    m.code AS material_code,
    m.name AS material_name,
    mp.effective_date,
    mp.unit_cost,
    mp.package_unit
   FROM material_prices mp
     JOIN materials m ON m.id = mp.material_id
  ORDER BY mp.material_id, mp.effective_date DESC, mp.created_at DESC;

views.name: v_recipe_cost
views.definition:
SELECT r.id AS recipe_id,
    r.product_id,
    p.sku,
    p.name AS product_name,
    r.version_no,
    r.effective_date,
    r.yield_qty,
    r.yield_unit,
    sum(ri.qty * (1::numeric + ri.wastage_pct / 100.0) * COALESCE(lmc.unit_cost, 0::numeric)) AS batch_material_cost,
        CASE
            WHEN r.yield_qty > 0::numeric THEN sum(ri.qty * (1::numeric + ri.wastage_pct / 100.0) * COALESCE(lmc.unit_cost, 0::numeric)) / r.yield_qty
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS material_cost_per_yield_unit
   FROM recipes r
     JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id
     JOIN recipe_items ri ON ri.recipe_id = r.id
     LEFT JOIN v_latest_material_cost lmc ON lmc.material_id = ri.material_id
  WHERE r.is_active = true
  GROUP BY r.id, r.product_id, p.sku, p.name, r.version_no, r.effective_date, r.yield_qty, r.yield_unit;

private_functions.name: is_app_member
private_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_app_member(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.app_members am
    where am.user_id = p_user_id
      and am.active = true
  );
$function$
